english: Whoa, amaaazing!\nMion-san! Do it again! Again!!
Leave it to me! Here we go!
Amaaazing!
Hm? What're you guys making a racket about?
Oh, Chris-san! Look! It's amazing!
The stones Mion-san throws\nhop across the water\nlike bunnies — pyon-pyon!
She's teaching me too,\nbut I can't get it right.
Heheh, it's called mizukiri!
Whoa, nice...\nUh, like this, like this...
Like this, like this...
Ngh...
Ei! Ya!! ...There.
Oh, I kinda did it!!
Tch.
No no, Chris... hold it sideways like this...\nlean your body like this...
Daaah!!\nThis is boring, boring!!
This really ain't my thing...\nlet's compete at something else!
A contest?\nHaha, that wasn't the plan,\nbut I can't back down from a challenge.
I'm fine with it~?
But...\nthe loser spends the whole day\nin an embarrassing cosplay?
Oh, you're on!\nOkay, so...\nthat branch floating over there —
whoever hits it with the most stones wins!
Oh, nice!\nI won't lose —\nlet's do 10 throws each!
Okay! I've got confidence in that one!
Yes! Hit it again! That's three!
Oh, not bad —\ncan't let you beat me either.
Ngh...
Hit! That ties me for first!\nChris has zero!\nBetter try hard or it's cosplay for you.
Mrgh...
Whoa! So close!!\nJust a little more! Next one's the last!
Last one for me too!\nNo hard feelings, whoever wins!
Well, the punishment game's decided for Chris...\nwait, huh?
Where'd Chris go...?\n...Hah, I see...\nscared off, huh...
M-Mion-san, behind you, behind you! Danger!!
Huh? Behind...?
...Ngh... grrrgh.
W-w-whoa, wait wait, time out!\nChris! What are you gonna do with that huge rock!?\nDon't tell me...
Dooooryaaaah!!
Huff... huff... huff...
Heh, hmph!! How's that! See that!?\nThe branch is gone without a trace!\nThat's my win!!
Pfft!
Ahahahaha.
Ahahaha!\nOh man, that's rich!!\nRules? What rules!
Heehee. Okay okay, fine!\nWe'll call this one Chris's win.
Y-yeah, as long as you get it... so,\nthe cosplay...
So\nthat's one win for me and one for Chris —\nwe'll settle it another time!
I won't lose next time!
Oh? Ooh! I ain't losin'!
Hey hey! Next let's do a footrace!
Nice!\nI wonder what cosplay the loser wears...
Ngh... always with the cosplay...
Chris-san\nreally hates cosplay, huh!
What I hate, I hate!!
Forcing someone who hates it... ngh...\nthis old man's getting a nosebleed already...
Kuuuh! I ain't ever losing!!
Huh? Mion-san, you dropped something.
Th-that leotard\nwith a swan attached at the crotch...\nwhat IS that...
Oops, my bad, my bad —\ndropped it.
W-wait... no way...\nTHAT's the cosplay...?
Ahahaha, I'm getting all excited!
Fufufu, Chris wearing THIS~ —\ncan't wait.
Why is everyone assuming I'M gonna lose...\nno wait, that's not even the point...\nhey... HEY, listen to meeee!
